comments.author: @jeffreymackenzie7369
comments.text: I worked in Microsoft XBox support around 2005 and we used a call center support system to answer customer calls.  It filled in the customer personal information based on voice recognition before the call was transferred to an agent and then walked the agent through the process of fixing the customer's problem using a series of menus the agent selected to narrow the problem down and read the responses for the customer to perform. They call that AI now but it was just an organized database of information back then. The number one use case for AI is still just performing call center duties but it can now respond to queries and also summarize information and write report summaries.

Grow yourself and grow into the new jobs coming.
